name: Anubis
title: Shepherd of Shadows
summary: Balance the scales as you defeat your foes and drain their Turn Meter and Divinity.
lore: Guide to the dead of Aaru and guardian of the underworld’s gates, Anubis has always been a grim deity, but he grew ever more distant in the years preceding the Shattering. Yet he seems, peculiarly, to have regained a new sense of purpose since the world was remade, though it is one that often keeps him traveling, away from his sacred duties.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If an enemy is defeated, Decrease the cooldown of this ability by 1 turn.
If the enemy is defeated, also steal 20% Divinity from all enemies.
If the hero is an enemy, place [Banish] for 1 turn. If the hero is an ally, gain 200 Divinity.
